lines.text: Want some carrots, Rabbity?
Rabbity in the mountains, rabbity in the meadow, oh where oh where can he be?
Rabbity, I'm just so happy whenever you're around.
I finished all the books you gave me!
Rabbity... could you hold my hand?
To me, you are my Elysium. Forever and always.
You're not... going to Elysium alone, are you?
Rabbity, take me to Elysium!
Let's hop around, you and me!
I'm heading to what we call a clothing store. Wanna come?
At a clothing store, there are clothes as far as the eye can see! It's fit for a princess!
Rabbity, please take me to a world where everyone lives in happiness.
Wow! Am I getting stronger?
This strength... I can feel it coursing through me!
Now we can have even more fun!
A gift... for me?
Thanks a lot!
I'll give you a present next time in return! I promise!
You're the best, Rabbity! Just the best!
Take my hand!
Could you bring me to Elysium right now, please?
I really do enjoy being with you.
Hey! Hey, Rabbity!
Whoa, woo-hoo!
Is this one of those encounters everyone is talking about?
Let's have some fun!
C'mon guys! Turn those frowns upside down!
Hey, Rabbity! Let's have some fun!
Shhh, I'm hiding!
Aha! Like this!
Give me a few minutes and I'll be right back into it!
Perfect timing!
Everyone will have a blast in Wonderland!
Aren't we having such a great time together?!
Gotcha!
Oh no, they fainted!
I'll go find someone else to play with!
That hurt!
Argh!
Eeep!
Huh? Why can't I move?
We won!

A hop and a skip, la la la...
Who will I meet on the way?
Aren't I cute as a button?
Rabbits jump like this, right? Boing, boing!
I wanna spend the whole day with you.

I'm off to a place where love reigns supreme!
Are you coming with me?
Let's go eat some fluffy cotton candy together.

Rabbity? Where are you?
You said you'd take me to the Ark!

I can't wait to spend more time with you!
So hop on over here, quick!
Where do I want to go...? Anywhere, if it's with you!
I wanna check out the toy store!
I want to go for a walk in the park with you, hand in hand.
Are we going to the Ark? Yippee!
I wanna play here all day!
A hop and a skip, la la la...
Wowee! Thanks for sharing your strength with me!
Is this a souvenir from the Ark? Thank you!
A gift from Rabbity... I'll cherish it forever!

I want to get you a gift, too!
What do you want?
I want to be with you forever and ever.
This is the happiest place in the world!
I think I'm starting to catch feelings for you, Rabbity.
Can you tell me where we're going?
Are you calling me?
Let's go together!
Let's have fun together!
Ok, everybody! Let's do it!
I'll show you what a rabbit can do!
Let's finish this quickly and go have some fun.
A-one, and a-two...
Hehe, you can't see me!
Just a moment, please...
Rabbity!
Off to the land of eternal happiness you go!
Yahoo! I'm so happy!
Did I do well?
There's more where that came from.
Hey! A compliment would be nice.
Ow!
Kyaa!
*Sob*
Maybe we can just play together next time...
All done! Now, are we gonna go have some fun or what?
A marvelous tea party is about to begin!
There are so many of your friends here, Rabbity!
Doesn't it feel like we've stepped right into a fairy tale?
This is the world of happiness I've always dreamed of! Thank you for coming with me, Rabbity.
Your seat is right next to mine, Rabbity! Because... I absolutely adore you!
Even if I wake from this dream, it's okay, because you'll still be right here with me!
Aww... The tea party can't start without you, Rabbity...
Were you having a nice dream, Rabbity? Be sure to invite me!
Everyone's smiling so brightly! I guess it's because this world is full of happiness!
I want to walk by your side, Rabbity!
If we hold the tea party here, I'm sure lots of guests will come!
Welcome to my dream world, Rabbity!
Wow! I feel like I'm soaring through the sky!
I'll protect you in this world, Rabbity!
How do I look? Do I seem stronger?
Wow, this gift feels like a dream come true!
As a thank you, I'll invite you to a fabulous tea party!
I love anything you give me, Rabbity!
I want to stay here with you and live happily ever after, Rabbity!
My heart's pounding! Even in my dream, I can feel it racing!
I feel like a princess from a fairy tale!
All together now—to the world of happiness!
Yep! I'm right here!
A hop and a skip!
Did you all come to enjoy the tea party too?
Let's have fun together!
Hello there!
So many guests!
I'm all out of ingredients!
There's so much to prepare...!
I'll be right back!
All set!
Welcome to Alice's tea party!
May happiness be with you all!
I did a good job, right?
Take care on your way out!
Come visit again!
Ouch!
That hurt...!
Oh no... I think I'm about to wake up from my dream...
Wow, that was such a happy tea party!
